# Korelyy Tools

> Korelyy (korelyy.com) is a free, privacy-first online tools hub. All tools run 100% in the browser, no upload, no signup required. Available in 6 languages: English, 中文, Español, Français, हिन्दी, العربية.

## About
- Free to use, no registration, no watermark.
- Client-side processing: files never leave your device.
- 40+ original tools plus curated external tools and multi-step workflows.

## Core Tools
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/password-generator/` : Create strong random passwords in the browser.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/image-compressor/` : Compress JPG/PNG/WebP locally without quality loss.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/color-picker/` : Pick colors, get HEX/RGB/HSL codes.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/regex-tester/` : Test and debug regular expressions live.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/json-formatter/` : Format, validate and minify JSON.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/mortgage-calculator/` : Estimate monthly payments and amortization.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/text-to-speech/` : Convert text to natural speech in the browser.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/pdf-merger/` : Merge multiple PDF files locally.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/timestamp-converter/` : Convert Unix timestamps to dates.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/base64-tool/` : Encode/decode Base64 text and files.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/url-encode-decode/` : Encode or decode URL strings.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/case-converter/` : Convert text case (upper/lower/camel/snake).
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/uuid-generator/` : Generate UUID v4 identifiers.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/countdown/` : Create countdown timers for events.
- `https://korelyy.com/en/tool/decision-wheel/` : Spin a wheel to make random choices.
